name: Pedahzur
overview: Pedahzur is identified in Scripture as the father of Gamaliel, a prominent leader of the tribe of Manasseh. The passages in Numbers highlight Gamaliel’s role as captain and prince over his tribe, emphasizing his leadership during the organization and offerings of Israel’s camp. Through Gamaliel, Pedahzur is connected to the faithful stewardship and service of God's people as they prepared for their journey, demonstrating the importance of godly leadership within the tribal structure established by God.
